subject: Draft MAP: Procurement intake & Ariba kickstart — next milestones
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sam Tanner <sam.tanner@acmeinc.com>, Lori Shaw <lori.shaw@acmeinc.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP: Procurement intake & Ariba kickstart — next milestones

Thanks again for the call this morning — good to get procurement and engineering aligned. As promised, first pass below for a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on vendor onboarding and Ariba/Coupa setup so we can target a May 27 go-live for API access. This is intentionally concise so procurement has clear asks and Redwood knows dependencies.

Proposed MAP (milestones, owners, dependencies, target dates)
1) Vendor enrollment form submitted (Acme)
   - Owner: Acme procurement (Sam/Lori)
   - Dependency: Standard supplier form + W-9
   - Target: 2027-05-03

2) Vendor record created in Ariba / Coupa (Acme IT/Procurement)
   - Owner: Acme procurement (Lori) / Acme IT (internal)
   - Dependency: Enrollment form completed, tax docs, bank details
   - Target: 2027-05-10

3) Redwood vendor activation (Redwood Ops)
   - Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood)
   - Dependency: Ariba vendor ID (or Coupa PO/ID), signed SOW/contract terms
   - Target: 2027-05-12

4) Test provisioning & smoke test (Redwood + Acme devs)
   - Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood) + Acme dev lead
   - Dependency: Activation complete, credentials in place, network allowlist
   - Target: 2027-05-20

5) Production enablement (cutover)
   - Owner: Joint (Redwood Ops / Acme procurement & infra)
   - Dependency: Successful test, billing setup, support contacts
   - Target: 2027-05-27 (target close date)

Open items / asks for Acme procurement:
- Please confirm which system you want Redwood to register in (Ariba vs Coupa). If Ariba, we need the vendor ID and preferred payee name exactly as it should appear.
- Upload completed supplier intake + W-9. I attached a one-sheet W-9 request to speed this up.
- Banking details (ACH) — we can accept a redacted voided check or bank letter.

Next steps on Redwood side:
- I attached MAP_Redwood-Acme_v0.2.pdf with milestones and a simple responsibility matrix (Ben/Marissa are internal owners).
- Ben will prepare the activation checklist for vendor activation in our ops queue.
- Marissa will schedule the provisioning test slot for week of May 17.

If this looks right, can someone from Acme reply with: (1) preferred registration system, (2) estimated date you can submit the intake form/W-9, and (3) the billing contact for PO/invoice routing?

Thanks —

Mina Haddad
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0179
Attachment: MAP_Redwood-Acme_v0.2.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: Acme_W9_Request.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sam Tanner <sam.tanner@acmeinc.com>, Lori Shaw <lori.shaw@acmeinc.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Procurement intake & Ariba kickstart — next milestones

Thanks Mina — +1 to the timeline. A couple tactical notes from ops so Acme can prep: 
- For Ariba registration we need the exact legal entity name and TAX ID to avoid registration delays. If you register in Coupa, please confirm whether you use the vendor portal or want Redwood to create the vendor record on your behalf (we can do this but need a PO contact).
- If Acme will submit the W-9 into Ariba/Coupa, great. If not, they can email our secure intake (vendors@redwood.ai) — we'll upload on their behalf but need explicit consent in the email.
- I'll create the activation checklist and post it to the shared Drive folder (link in the MAP). Expected internal lead time once docs are received: 5 business days to complete activation.

Quick Q: Marissa, can you confirm availability for a 60-min provisioning test between May 17–19? I can block tentative slots.

Ben Carter
Head of Customer Ops — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Thanks Mina — this is helpful and aligns with our procurement timeline. A few notes/questions from Acme procurement: 
- We will register Redwood in Ariba. I can take the enrollment form and W-9 offline; target to upload both by 2027-05-04 (one day after your requested date) — is that okay?
- Legal asks whether Redwood requires any PO terms up front or if a standard PO after vendor creation is sufficient. We typically issue the PO at activation. Please confirm.
- For banking details, we need Redwood's preferred remittance instructions and whether Redwood accepts NET30 (preferred) or requires earlier terms.

Action: I will upload enrollment + W-9 by 2027-05-04. Sam will be the technical contact for provisioning tests; I copied him here.

Lori Shaw

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Procurement intake & Ariba kickstart — next milestones

Appreciate the quick reply, Lori — thanks for the upload target of May 4, that works. Quick answers to your legal/billing questions: 
- PO timing: Standard PO post-activation is fine for Redwood; we do not require a PO to create a vendor record in our system. If Acme needs terms appended to the PO, we can accept the PO + reference SOW.
- Billing terms: Redwood's default is NET30. If Acme requires NET45 for internal purposes, we can discuss but NET30 is standard.
- Remittance: I'll have Ben add the remittance instructions to the shared Drive (will post by EOD).

Updated asks for Acme (confirming items and dates)
- Preferred registration: Ariba (confirmed by Lori) — please reply with vendor ID once created.
- Enrollment + W-9: target upload 2027-05-04 (Lori)
- Billing contact (for PO/invoice routing): please share name/email
- Provisioning test contact: Sam Tanner — please share Sam's preferred time windows for May 17–19.

I attached the MAP_Redwood-Acme_v0.2.pdf again with the updated target dates and a short responsibilities matrix. I'll schedule a 30-min sync for next week to walk procurement through the minimal fields we need in Ariba to avoid back-and-forth. Tentative time: Tue 2027-05-04 10:00AM PT — let me know if that conflicts with your calendar and I'll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Mina Haddad
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0179
